name: WAS AIX JVM batch
description: Which batch of application server JVMs to stop or start: the JVMs whose maximum heap is in the batch's range (inventories/aix/group_vars/all/45_jvm_batches.yml).

spec.question_description: 512: -Xmx up to 512 MB. 1024: up to 1024 MB. 1536: up to 1536 MB. 2048: up to 2048 MB. ALL: every JVM of the node, the ones above 2048 MB included. The JVMs of a batch are stopped, or started, all at once.
